If equipment costs over the threshold, I treat it as capex: instead of the default small-tools booking, I move the expense account to Plants and Machineries and set the cost center to Production. I save the corrected invoice. On the invoice list for the next supplier, if the amount matches an already-paid December invoice, I recognize it as a suspected duplicate, not a normal booking. I hold that suspected duplicate until the supplier confirms — I don't book it, even with the old invoice number plus a suffix. I save the held invoice. For the next invoice, I identify it as belonging to the UK subsidiary. Did I get that right?
